$comment: SR-136 license policy encoding, verbatim from docs/plan/04-security-program.md §6.13. Consumed by tools/ci/security_gate.py license evaluation. Do not restate SR-136 prose elsewhere (C-16.5) — this file *is* the machine-readable copy.

needs_approval.$comment: LGPL requires security + owner approval per SR-136. A licence in this list fails the build with CI-SEC-003 unless an accepted-risk entry (security/accepted-risks.yaml) names the exact finding id and is unexpired.

prohibited.$comment: Prohibited in shipped code per SR-136. Dev-only tooling may use GPL where it is not distributed — see dev_only_exceptions below.

dev_only_exceptions.$comment: Packages that carry a prohibited licence but are dev-only tooling, never distributed with shipped code (SR-136 dev-only carve-out). Each entry requires a package name (ecosystem-qualified) and a reason; still fails for any dependency reachable from a production build target.
